ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, estimated at approximately 85-90% coverage, with sparse high-intensity (white) pixels appearing as narrow linear and punctate regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark substrate across both lobes. Disrupted by high-contrast white linear filaments and streaks oriented in various diagonal axes. Small high-intensity white blobs are localized at the distal tips and proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular boundary with varying pixel-amplitude. Left lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits a distinct, deep semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge. Right lobe exhibits smaller, high-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow an upward convex trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white punctate pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense distribution of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable missing tissue/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive coverage of linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral area.
